entities.name: Human glycogen branching enzyme
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q04446; 702 aa and 100% identity/coverage.
Annotated as 1,4-alpha-glucan branching enzyme, EC 2.4.1.18, acting in glycogen biosynthesis.
Contains CBM_48, Alpha-amylase, and Alpha-amylase_C domains, consistent with glucan branching activity.

entities.name: Alpha-glucan branching reaction
observations: Transfers a segment of a (1→4)-alpha-D-glucan chain to a primary hydroxyl group in a similar glucan chain, creating an alpha-(1→6) branch.
The reaction is catalyzed by glycogen branching enzyme EC 2.4.1.18 and supports glycogen biosynthesis.

entities.name: Glycogen biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme participates in glycogen biosynthesis with glycogenin and glycogen synthase.
Branch formation increases the solubility and structural organization of glycogen.
